hypotheses.justification: Let A = X ⊞ Y and F = tensorRight Aᘁ. Rigidity makes F a left adjoint via tensorRightAdjunction, so it preserves coproducts and zero morphisms (preservesZeroMorphisms_of_isLeftAdjoint). Thus preservesBinaryBiproduct_of_preservesBinaryCoproduct applies. Applying IsBilimit.binary_total to isBinaryBilimitOfPreserves gives F.map biprod.fst ≫ F.map biprod.inl + F.map biprod.snd ≫ F.map biprod.inr = 𝟙 (F.obj A). Insert this identity into rightTrace_def and distribute composition using Preadditive alone. Functoriality identifies the two summands as rightTrace (biprod.fst ≫ biprod.inl ≫ f) and its snd/inr counterpart; rightTrace_comm yields the conclusion. This bypasses rightTrace_add and needs no tensor additivity. The argument also covers zero objects and trivial hom groups.
